look_here_first: LOOK FIRST at a mature anthocarp: it should be glabrous, with relatively acute five ribs and a truncate to low-conic apex. Then inspect the loose branching flower clusters and whether leaves are mostly on the lower part of an often annual plant.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Small white to pinkish flowers in diffuse branching clusters; single petaloid perianth whorl.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Mature anthocarps about 2.7–4 mm, glabrous, with acute ribs and truncate/low-conic apex.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Usually annual habit; leaves concentrated mostly in the lower half of the plant. Leaf distribution alone is not decisive.
